content: Copilot CLI non-interactive/programmatic: copilot -p/--prompt, -s (silent clean output), --allow-tool/--deny-tool/--allow-url/--add-dir/--allow-all, --no-ask-user, --model, --agent, --share/--share-gist, --secret-env-vars. Env: COPILOT_MODEL, COPILOT_HOME, COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN/GH_TOKEN/GITHUB_TOKEN. MCP via ~/.copilot/mcp-config.json (stdio/http/sse). No documented JSON output. CLI flags are a fallback integration surface; the SDK is preferred. Stability risk: issue #1606 removed --headless --stdio breaking older SDK.
